source_text: The total surface area of neocortex of one hemisphere, including cingulate cortex, is only about 15 mm2.

structure: chin, snout, vibrissae, and naris representation in S1
source_text: The representations of the chin, snout, vibrissae, and naris occupied approximately half of the entire body representation within S1.
A second representation of the body surface was found in a small oval of cortex, roughly 1.5 mm2, just lateral to S1.
S1 was approximately 1.2-1.4 mm in rostrocaudal width.
S1 was a little more than 2 mm in mediolateral length.
The auditory oval was a little over 1 mm in rostrocaudal length.
The auditory oval was about 1 mm in mediolateral width.
In a surface area of 15 mm2 there may be 13 or more distinct processing divisions.
